subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Analisar obras significativas das literaturas brasileiras e de outros países e povos, em especial a portuguesa, a indígena, a africana e a latino-americana, com base em ferramentas da crítica literária (estrutura da composição, estilo, aspectos discursivos) ou outros critérios relacionados a diferentes matrizes culturais, considerando o contexto de produção (visões de mundo, diálogos com outros textos, inserções em movimentos estéticos e culturais etc.) e o modo como dialogam com o presente.

components.description_pt: Analisar obra literária usando ferramentas de crítica literária—estrutura composicional, estilo e aspectos discursivos
components.description_en: Analyze a literary work using tools of literary criticism—compositional structure, style, and discursive aspects
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how an author's purpose influences the style and tone of a text

components.description_pt: Situar obra literária dentro de seu contexto de produção, incluindo movimentos estéticos e culturais
components.description_en: Situate a literary work within its context of production, including aesthetic and cultural movements
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a foundational American literary work reflects the values or concerns of its historical period

components.description_pt: Interpretar como obra literária significativa do Brasil ou outro país dialoga com o presente
components.description_en: Interpret the ways in which a significant literary work from Brazil or another country speaks to the present
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a foundational American literary work reflects the values or concerns of its historical period

components.description_pt: Comparar obras literárias de diferentes tradições nacionais usando critérios analíticos culturalmente apropriados
components.description_en: Compare literary works from different national traditions using culturally appropriate analytical criteria
components.cc_component_description: Compare the treatment of similar themes across stories or myths from different cultures

cc_matches.description: Demonstrate knowledge of eighteenth-, nineteenth- and early-twentieth-century foundational works of American literature, including how two or more texts from the same period treat similar themes or topics.
Assess how point of view or purpose shapes the content and style of a text.

Compare and contrast the treatment of similar themes and topics (e.g., opposition of good and evil) and patterns of events (e.g., the quest) in stories, myths, and traditional literature from different cultures.
